description: Reverse-ETL sink: mirror an upstream DataFrame into a Microsoft Dynamics 365 (Dataverse) entity set via its native alternate-key upsert endpoint. `PATCH {org_url}/api/data/{api_version}/{entity_set}({key}='{value}')` atomically creates or updates in one request -- no search-then-write. One PATCH per row (Dataverse has no single-call bulk/composite upsert the way Salesforce does).

inputs.description: pandas DataFrame from an upstream asset. Each row → one Dataverse record (upserted via alternate_key_field).

outputs.description: Dagster asset materialization with metadata (rows_created / rows_updated / rows_unknown_action / rows_errored). No downstream data -- the write side effect lands in Dataverse.

upstream_asset_key.label: Upstream Asset Key
upstream_asset_key.description: Upstream Dagster asset providing the DataFrame. Mutually exclusive with `source:`.

source.label: Source
source.description: Inline source config. Mutually exclusive with `upstream_asset_key`. Shapes: {kind: sql, resource_key/database_url_env_var, query}, {kind: csv, path, read_csv_kwargs}, {kind: inline, rows}.

entity_set_name.label: Entity Set Name
entity_set_name.description: Target Dataverse entity SET name -- plural, lowercase logical name (e.g. 'accounts', 'contacts', 'leads', 'opportunities', or a custom table's plural logical name).

alternate_key_field.label: Alternate Key Field
alternate_key_field.description: Dataverse field logical name used as the upsert match key -- MUST be a pre-defined Alternate Key on the table. MUST be present in fields_map values.

fields_map.label: Fields Map
fields_map.description: Upstream column → Dataverse field logical name.

batch_size.label: Batch Size
batch_size.description: Max upstream rows per run (safety cap). One PATCH per row.

prefer_representation.label: Prefer Representation
prefer_representation.description: Send Prefer: return=representation so 201/200 distinguishes created vs. updated and the GUID comes back inline. False skips the extra server-side retrieve but reports every row's action as 'unknown'.

name: Dynamics CRM Record Upsert
